scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Whew...!
Still, he won't eat anything unless it's Meat. But maybe he will eat fruit if it was cut so that it was easy to eat. Like, if it was blended into juice...
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
呼...！
不过，除非是肉，否则他什么都吃不下。但如果把水果切成容易吃的样子，他也许会吃吧。比如，把它打成果汁...

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Ah! Come to think of it, I heard they were making fruit juice somewhere. Now where was it... Payon Village, or Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
啊！说起来，我听说有人在制作果汁。是在哪里来着...斐扬村，还是莫洛奇？

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Eat some fruits!! You don't want to become a slobby fat pig when you grow up, do you?
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
莫里森！！吃点水果吧！！你难道不想长大后变成一只邋遢的肥猪吗？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Hm? ...You!
You're the one who gave, my little Morrison that Meat?! Did you come here thinking I wouldn't know about it?!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
嗯？...就是你！
就是你给了我儿子莫里森肉吃？！你以为我不知道吗？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Go away, get out of my house NOW!!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
滚开，马上给我滚出我家！！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! I'm going to be very very mad if you keep doing this!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
莫里森！！如果你再这样下去，我会非常非常生气的！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Oh!!.... This...
what is this...??
How could you do something like this to my boy?!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
哦！！.... 这...
这是什么...？
你怎么能对我的儿子做这种事？！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Argh! Get out of my house right this instant!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
啊！马上给我滚出我家！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! Please eat some fruits!! Please~!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
莫里森！！请吃点水果吧！！拜托了~！

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marinaa]
Sigh~!! Like father, like son...
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽娜]
唉~！！真是有其父必有其子...

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
*Sigh*... This is Morrison...
My one and only son.
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
*叹气*... 这就是莫里森...
我唯一的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
But these days, he just won't eat fruits. His face is so dull because he refuses to eat healthy. He just wants to eat Meat. I need to find a way to feed him fruits or vegetables....
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
但最近，他怎么也不肯吃水果。因为拒绝吃健康的食物，他的脸色看起来很差。他只想要吃肉。我得想办法让他吃点水果或蔬菜....

scripts.text:
[Housewife Marianne]
Morrison!! You're going to be in big trouble if you keep this up!
scripts.translation:
[主妇 玛丽安]
莫里森！！如果你再这样下去，你就大祸临头了！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Bleh... Forget it.
I'm just going to shrivel to death just eating fruits. Don't bother worrying about me .
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
呸... 算了。
光吃水果我迟早会饿死的。别为我担心了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ah... so full~
I think I can live now.
You don't have to give me any more Meat. I feel like I'm going to explode if I eat any more.
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊... 好饱~
我觉得我现在能活下去了。
不用再给我肉了。再吃下去我感觉自己要爆炸了。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Oh... and... um.
Take this.
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
哦... 还有... 那个。
拿着这个。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
It's a little something I've been saving to eat for later, but since you gave me Meat, I think I can pass on the sweets.
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
这是我留着以后吃的点心，但既然你给了我肉吃，我觉得我可以把这些甜点让给你。

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Agh....Noooo!!!
No, don't make me eat it! I can't bear to taste fruits!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊.... 不！！！
不，别逼我吃！我受不了水果的味道！

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Show the Meat
scripts.translation: 出示肉

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaagh!! Once or twice is enough!! I refuse to eat any more fruits! You have to peel them and there's so much juice that it makes you feel icky...
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊啊啊！！一两次就够了！！我拒绝再吃水果了！还得剥皮，而且汁水太多，吃起来黏糊糊的...

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
And they're all slippery and sour... Even if I eat it, I still feel hungry. Aaaah~! Give me Meat!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
而且它们又滑又酸...就算吃了，我还是觉得饿。啊啊啊~！给我肉吃！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Ooh! M-Meaaat~
Ah... hu...hungry...
The scent of Meat...
Excuse me...
C-can I please have one?
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
噢！肉...肉~
啊...好...好饿...
肉的味道...
打扰一下...
能...能给我一块吗？

scripts.text: Give Meat
scripts.translation: 给肉

scripts.text: Don't Give Meat
scripts.translation: 不给肉

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Wow~!!! Meat!!
So yummy!
Thank you,
I think I can
live now.
*Chew chew*
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
哇~！！！肉！！
太好吃了！
谢谢你，
我觉得我
活过来了。
*咀嚼声*

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Waah...!
Fine, I get it now.
Adults are all the same!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
哇啊...！
好吧，我明白了。
大人都是这样的！

scripts.text:
[Little Morrison]
Aaaaah!!! No matter what, I'm not going to eat fruits and vegetables!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊啊啊！！！无论如何，我都不吃水果和蔬菜！

Aaah!! I can't eat any more fruits!
scripts.translation:
[小 莫里森]
啊啊！！我再也吃不下水果了！

scripts.text:

I refuse to eat any more fruits! You have to peel them and there's so much juice that it makes you feel icky...
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Give me Meat!

啊啊啊~！
给我肉吃！

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Welcome.
Did you come to
process fruits as well?
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
欢迎光临。
您也是来
加工水果的吗？

scripts.text: Make Juice.
scripts.translation: 制作果汁

scripts.text: Talk and get information about fruit processing.
scripts.translation: 交谈并获取水果加工资讯

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
What kind of fruit juice would you like to make?
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
您想制作哪种果汁？

scripts.text: Apple Juice
scripts.translation: 苹果汁

scripts.text: Banana Juice
scripts.translation: 香蕉汁

scripts.text: Carrot Juice
scripts.translation: 红萝卜汁

scripts.text: Grape Juice
scripts.translation: 葡萄汁

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
那么...
下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. To make {0}, I need 1 {1} and 1 Empty Bottle. I will also need a 3 zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
哎呀...
您没有备齐所有材料。制作{0}，我需要1个{1}和1个空瓶。另外还需要3 Zeny的手续费。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
When you have prepared everything, I will blend the fruit to give you delicious juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
当您备齐所有材料后，我会将水果搅拌成美味的果汁。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
How many would you like?
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
您想要多少？

scripts.text: As many as I can.
scripts.translation: 尽可能多

scripts.text: I want a certain amount.
scripts.translation: 指定数量

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Choose a number less than 100. If you don't want to, put '0'. You can make up to {0} bottles of juice.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
请输入100以下的数字。如果不想制作，请输入“0”。
您最多可以制作{0}瓶果汁。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
那么...
欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
More than 100 bottles is impossible. Choose a different amount.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
超过100瓶是不可能的。请重新选择数量。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
那么...
欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Oh no...
You don't have all the necessary materials. I can't help a situation like this. I guess you collect what you need.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
哎呀...
您没有备齐所有材料。我帮不了您。看来您得先去收集所需的材料了。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Here you go! Fresh and delicious juice as promised. It should be very refreshing and palatable.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
给您！
正如承诺的那样，新鲜美味的果汁。喝起来一定很清爽可口。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Well then...
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
那么...
欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Before humans were able to develop such vast societies, they gathered fruit from trees to survive. Fruits may have been nature's blessing that allowed us to exist in the world.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
在人类能够建立如此庞大的社会之前，他们靠采摘树上的果实生存。
水果也许是大自然赐予我们的恩惠，让我们得以在这个世界上生存。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
Since life became so prosperous, the younger generation seems not to eat fruit any more. So, I started thinking of ways to make fruit easier to eat.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
自从生活变得富裕起来，年轻人似乎不再吃水果了。
所以，我开始思考如何让水果更容易食用。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Marx Hansen]
I realized that when you make fruit juice, it's more convenient to eat and has a much better taste.
scripts.translation:
[商人 马克斯·汉森]
我发现，把水果做成果汁，不仅食用起来更方便，味道也更好。
